# Get Images From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets Images from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getImagesFrom(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getImagesFrom(input: Clipboard)
~~~~
